podcast.body: In the liner notes for this album, Kurt Cobain referred to two individuals who sexually assaulted a girl during a live performance of "Polly" on the 1991 *Nevermind* tour as "two wastes of sperm and eggs." "These two thugs are described by Kurt in the liner notes of the Incestosite album as two wastes of sperm and eggs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
